run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the minimum rotations required to get the same string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against sample inputs to verify minimum rotation count results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes minimum rotations by comparing substrings of a doubled string
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use more efficient string matching instead of substring slicing
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty strings or single character inputs
